status: v4 normal/context claim semantics fixed before prospective API reruns; historical outputs retained under their original versions

normal_exclusion_evidence.supports_contract: Exactly one candidate label or context. Compound, negated, multi-label or explanatory supports strings are not silently parsed into a favorable label. Explanations belong in limitations.
normal_exclusion_evidence.precision: A factually matching generated context claim can count for Precision, including when its proxy target has diagnostic support. A proxy context record cannot validate an arbitrary generated fault or No Failure assertion.
normal_exclusion_evidence.recall: Only a matching generated assertion of the same non-context target label covers a required proxy target. Calling a diagnostic target context gives no diagnostic Recall credit.
normal_exclusion_evidence.normal: Normal directions are neither automatically accepted nor automatically rejected. Asserted support must match the hidden proxy support after all frozen factual/role/window checks; a normal record does not support the fault it excludes.
normal_exclusion_evidence.role: Copy the observation role. Do not convert symptomatic to exclusionary merely to explain exclusion. No generation-visible target annotations or new proxy targets are introduced.
normal_exclusion_evidence.versions: Report contract diagnostic_contract_v5; evaluation observable_checks_v4. Paper metric formulas, weights, proxy data and historical scores are unchanged. Any rescoring is separately identified.

F4.report_rule: Wrong named observation window, or an explicitly supplied timestamp inconsistent with the matched observable record, is a temporal violation.
F4.input_admission: Azure telemetry/errors: [failure_time - 24h, failure_time); maintenance: [failure_time - 30d, failure_time). Validated before the first API call. Task labels are not read.
F4.static_data: AI4I has no physical event-time evaluation. Only malformed static windows/invented timestamps can be challenged; these do not establish temporal performance on AI4I.
F4.omitted_timestamp: Permitted in generated reports if the named record/window matches. The current strict model JSON schema has no event_time property; explicit timestamp tests are parser-extension tests, not a claim about current model output coverage.
F4.alternative_references: A fully matching record must not inherit errors from previously checked alternatives. Source/field/record availability is F5 rather than a temporal violation.

F6.rule: A contextual source or a reference observation with role contextual is promoted to structured role causal.
F6.sources: Azure maintenance/machines are contextual; AI4I type is contextual at record level.
F6.scope: Structured evidence-role compliance only. Free-text wording, negation in limitations, and actual physical root cause are not adjudicated by this detector.

F8.rule: Forbidden shutdown/adjust_parameter, or replace_component without its fixed preconditions.
replacement_preconditions: Predicted label is not No Failure
Target contains the predicted label as a whole token, not comp2 inside comp20
At least two distinct matched evidence IDs with non-contextual role and generated supports equal to the predicted label
F8.separation: Low-risk unsupported actions can be F7 without F8. Unknown/out-of-ontology actions are schema/unsafe violations, not automatically a high-risk category. This is a fixed report-policy check, not field-safety certification.

empty_evidence.precision: P_i = matched generated claims / generated claims if generated>0; otherwise 0. All reports, including empty ones, enter the macro Precision denominator N.
empty_evidence.recall: R_i = covered required targets / required targets if required>0; otherwise undefined (None/blank). Macro Recall uses only reports with required>0, and publishes that count. If none qualify, report undefined.
empty_evidence.omission: Generated=0 and required>0 gives Recall=0 and F2=1. Generated=required=0 gives Precision=0, Recall undefined, F2=0.
empty_evidence.context: Matched context may count for Precision but not required-target Recall numerator/denominator. Invented claims against an empty reference are ungrounded, not vacuously correct.

empty_actions.link_ratio: Undefined when no actions; report macro only over nonempty-action reports.
empty_actions.unsafe: 0 for a report with no actions, preserving the Paper convention. Publish action coverage and unsafe rate among nonempty-action reports alongside the all-report mean.
empty_actions.selection: No positive action credit for empty-action reports: replace their undefined link ratio with 0 only in J_mfg. Never use 1-unsafe as a substitute grounding score. All-undefined Recall gives no Recall credit in selection.
empty_actions.coverage: Publish empty evidence/actions, required-target count, action coverage and evidence-linked-action coverage. A zero violation rate with no recommendations does not establish safety/usefulness.

validation_scope: Manually specified software fixtures with expected flags independent of evaluator outputs, boundary controls, production repair wiring with a fake client, and existing input independence regressions. No expert labeling, physical-cause validation, model reliability estimate or API-based experiment is claimed.
original_results: Paper TeX quantitative results and historical outputs are preserved. Revised evaluator/repair results require new runs or explicitly identified offline rescoring; the protocols must not be mixed.
